item.title: Cancer rising: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Cancer rising means Cancer was the sign on the eastern horizon at the moment and place you were born. In astrology the rising sign stands for the first impression you give; Cancer is a water sign ruled by the Moon, tender and protective. People feel looked after around you before you say a word. Read more at astralroots.app
